entries.009c0401bd3cb956: It handles the Petrochemical Base, polyolefins, basic chemicals, Sustainable Polymers, and engineering plastics. Polyethylene is made by Japan Polyethylene, and polypropylene by Japan Polypropylene.
entries.08da717d11db335b: This business makes MMA (methyl methacrylate) monomer, a raw material for acrylic resin, PMMA made from it, and coating materials, additives and modifiers used in paints and adhesives. The segment loss for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥1.5 billion, and the company attributes it mainly to the decline in market prices for MMA monomer and related products.
entries.15b3b86f3046bd52: A category that groups businesses not included in the reportable segments.
entries.1f444699df052792: This business makes feedstocks that form the foundation of petrochemicals, polyolefins, basic chemicals, engineering plastics, and carbon products such as coke. The segment loss for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥4.2 billion. The company states that it is pursuing structural reforms, such as withdrawing from the coke and carbon materials business and consolidating ethylene production facilities.
entries.3868ffc8d062616d: This category groups together businesses that are not included in the reportable segments. The company explains that the main ones are engineering and the transportation and warehousing businesses. They are carried out by Mitsubishi Chemical Engineering, Mitsubishi Chemical Logistics and others.

entries.c08de46c7dba4e39: This business produces and sells industrial gases such as oxygen, nitrogen and argon. It is carried out by Nippon Sanso Holdings, its subsidiary Taiyo Nippon Sanso (renamed Nippon Sanso effective April 1, 2026), Matheson Tri-Gas, Inc. in the United States, and others. In the fiscal year ended March 2026, it had the largest external revenue of the four reportable [[term:segment|segments]], and its segment profit (core operating income) of ¥200.7 billion was also the largest of any business.
